MicGuide_Title: Microphone access is blocked, but you can fix this!
MicGuide_Intro_Format: {0} requires microphone access to record and transcribe your messages.
Guide_EnableInWebChrome: To enable it in Google Chrome:
Guide_EnableInWebEdge: To enable it in Microsoft Edge:
Guide_EnableInWebSafari: To enable it in Apple Safari:
Guide_EnableInMobileChrome: To enable it in Google Chrome (mobile):
Guide_EnableInMobileEdge: To enable it in Microsoft Edge (mobile):
Guide_EnableInMobileSafari: To enable it in Safari or any other browser on iOS:
Guide_EnableInPhoneSettings: To enable it in your phone settings:
MicGuide_WebChromeStep1: Click "More" button in the upper right corner, and then click "Settings"
MicGuide_WebChromeStep2: Choose "Privacy and security" on the left side
MicGuide_WebChromeStep5: Check that you allow sites to ask to use your microphone
MicGuide_WebChromeStep6_Format: If "{0}" is not allowed to use microphone, select it
MicGuide_WebEdgeStep1: Click "⋯" > "Settings" on Windows, or "Microsoft Edge" > "Preferences" on MacOS
MicGuide_WebEdgeStep5_Format: Reopen {0} and allow it to use microphone
MicGuide_WebSafariStep4_Format: Change "{0}" entry's value from "Deny" to "Allow" or "Ask"
MicGuide_MobileChromeStep5: Enable "Ask first before allowing sites to use your microphone" option
MicGuide_MobileEdgeStep1: Tap middle button on the navigation bar
MicGuide_MobileEdgeStep6: Enable "Ask first before allowing sites to use your microphone" option
MicGuide_MobileEdgeStep7: Check if Edge itself has microphone access permission
MicGuide_MobileEdgeStep8: If not, allow Edge to use microphone
MicGuide_MobileSafariStep1: Open iOS Settings app, then "Safari" section
MicGuide_MobileSafariStep3: Change "Microphone access on all websites" to "Ask"
MicGuide_UnknownTitle_Format: {0} is unable to start audio recording
MicGuide_UnknownIntro: The most likely cause is that the microphone access permission isn't granted, although it could also be due to an issue on our end. To address this problem:
MicGuide_UnknownReload_Suffix: to perform a hot restart of the app.
MicGuide_UnknownReopen: If that doesn't help, try closing and reopening the app.
MicGuide_UnknownCheckInternet: If the above steps are not effective, please verify whether the app has internet access.

Bubble_PrivacyTitle: Your privacy is crucial for us
Bubble_PrivacyBelieveTarget: delivering the best communication experience is the best way for us to grow.
Bubble_PrivacyBelieve_Suffix: This experience implies strong privacy. In fact, even a single failure with user privacy may undermine almost two years of work we have spent so far building {0}.

Bubble_PrivacyRecording_Suffix: - even if happened due to a bug. If you see any signs of this (e.g., you see the iOS / Android microphone icon is on after you turn off the recording), please report this ASAP!
